assessment: This study reports important results and new insights into humoral immune responses to Plasmodium falciparum sexual stage proteins. The experiments are based on the use of target-agnostic memory B cell sorting and screening approaches as well as several state-of-the-art technologies. The authors present compelling evidence that one antibody, B1E11K, is cross-reactive with multiple proteins containing glutamate-rich repeats through homotypic interactions, a process similar to what has been observed for Plasmodium circumsporozoite protein repeat-directed antibodies.
